checks: Compatibility is exactly the actual-lifted-fiber hypothesis of the positive-depth support fact. Since β>0 and M>0, each deepest mark lies in the ordinary interior of a positive fiber, even when other fibers are null or the base rank is deficient.

A containing cap already costs at least βM by depth and at most βM by the cover assumption. If its margin at the mark were strictly positive, moving the threshold to the mark removes a positive slab of the own interior ball because the continuous normal is nonzero.

If the containing caps' inward continuous normals had convex hull separated from zero, a continuous direction would have negative dot product with every one. A small displacement in the same own fiber then misses them all, and still misses every other cap by finiteness and its strict negative original margin, contradicting coverage.

An inclusion-minimal convex representation of zero has all coefficients positive, no positive dependence in a proper subfamily, and size at most d+1 by Carathéodory. It is drawn from the original prescribed cover.

dependencies.hypotheses: The listed compact nonempty fibers are exact sections at their finite lattice-complete bases, and summed d-volume is positive. Its positive-depth equivalence puts the deepest mark's continuous component in the ordinary interior, the only support input used.
